import { test, expect, vi } from 'vitest'
vi.mock('ws2-genuine-external', () => ({
  value: 73,
  default: {
    value: 11,
  },
  label: 'mocked-cjs',
}))
vi.mock('ws2-genuine-external-original', async (importOriginal) => {
  const first = await importOriginal()
  const second = await importOriginal()
  return {
    value: first.value + 1,
    info: {
      value: first.value,
      defaultValue: first.default.value,
      fnType: typeof first.fn,
      tag: first[Symbol.toStringTag] ?? null,
      keys: Object.keys(first),
      same: first === second,
      objectIdentity: first.object === first.default.object,
    },
  }
})
vi.mock('ws2-genuine-external-esm', async (importOriginal) => {
  const first = await importOriginal()
  const second = await importOriginal()
  return {
    value: first.value + 1,
    info: {
      value: first.value,
      defaultValue: first.default.value,
      tag: first[Symbol.toStringTag] ?? null,
      keys: Object.keys(first),
      same: first === second,
    },
  }
})
import * as common from 'ws2-genuine-external'
import {
  value as actualValue,
  info as actualInfo,
} from 'ws2-genuine-external-original'
import { value as esmValue, info as esmInfo } from 'ws2-genuine-external-esm'
test('supplies an explicit real external CommonJS package factory', async () => {
  const dynamic = await import('ws2-genuine-external')
  const helper = await vi.importMock('ws2-genuine-external')
  {
    const observed = {
      value: common.value,
      defaultValue: common.default.value,
      label: common.label,
      namespaceIdentity: common === dynamic,
      helperIdentity: helper === common,
      defaultIdentity: helper.default === common.default,
    }
    expect(observed.value).toBe(73)
    expect(observed.defaultValue).toBe(11)
    expect(observed.label).toBe('mocked-cjs')
    expect(observed.namespaceIdentity).toBe(true)
    expect(observed.helperIdentity).toBe(false)
    expect(observed.defaultIdentity).toBe(true)
  }
  expect(common.value).toBe(73)
})
test('loads a real external CommonJS original through the lazy native graph', () => {
  {
    const observed = {
      value: actualValue,
      info: actualInfo,
    }
    expect(observed.value).toBe(20)
    expect(observed.info).toMatchObject({
      value: 19,
      defaultValue: 19,
      fnType: 'function',
      same: true,
      objectIdentity: true,
    })
  }
  expect(actualValue).toBe(20)
})
test('loads a real external ESM original through the lazy native graph', () => {
  {
    const observed = {
      value: esmValue,
      info: esmInfo,
    }
    expect(observed.value).toBe(38)
    expect(observed.info).toMatchObject({
      value: 37,
      defaultValue: 41,
      same: true,
    })
  }
  expect(esmValue).toBe(38)
})
